text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it also takes time and effort. When you visit a new country, you experience different cultures, traditions, and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, as every place has its own special dishes. However, language barriers can sometimes make things difficult. You might not understand what people say, or they might not understand you. Despite these challenges, travel creates unforgettable memories that stay with you forever. Meeting new people and seeing amazing places helps you grow and learn more about the world around you.
